query: how is memory tiering and decay handled

seed_memories.content: Memory tiering classifies rows into hot, warm, and cold using a streaming quantile estimator.
Per-cluster Kaplan-Meier survival curves replace fixed Ebbinghaus decay half-lives.
HDBSCAN groups memories into semantic clusters for per-cluster learning.
Cold tier memories are excluded from non-exploratory queries to keep recall focused.
Promotion from short-term to long-term memory uses cluster-aware strength signals.
